lines.label: viscoelastic joints (passive)
lines.note: always on; stiffness and damping per joint

lines.label: proprioceptive sensing
lines.note: timescale = sensory delay (s); ignites when a joint velocity exceeds the threshold (rad/s)

lines.label: vestibular / head-motion sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on trunk tilt rate (rad/s)

lines.label: visual feedback
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a visible COM offset (m); can be blocked

lines.label: tactile / contact-pressure sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a centre-of-pressure shift (m)

lines.label: cue perception
lines.note: timescale = delay; the movement / direction-change cues are sensed through it

lines.label: local joint reflex
lines.note: timescale = loop latency; ignites on a fast sensed joint motion

lines.label: central balance command (ankle)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed COM offset from the reference

lines.label: central balance command (hip)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a large COM offset

lines.label: central movement command (feed-forward)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed cue

lines.label: tonic co-contraction (core)
lines.note: baseline co-contraction level; costs energy while on

lines.label: breathing cycle
lines.note: timescale = period (s); modulates trunk drive and chest motion

lines.label: energy supply / fatigue
lines.note: timescale = fatigue time constant (s); internal, no observation model sees it directly

lines.label: gain adaptation
lines.note: timescale = adaptation time constant (s); slow retained state

labels.estimate: model-based estimate computed from observation outputs only
labels.observation: output of a simulated observation model applied to the reference (separate from it)
labels.reference: model reference state (simulator-internal; not an observation of a real body)

negative_results.statement: tensegrity: improved ['correction_latency'] without a detectable weakening elsewhere (no Fragility Transfer)
narrow-step-balance: improved ['correction_latency', 'turn_settling_after_push'] without a detectable weakening elsewhere (no Fragility Transfer)
fingertip-tension: improved ['posture_sway', 'recovery_region', 'turn_settling_after_push'] without a detectable weakening elsewhere (no Fragility Transfer)
anti-collapse-posture: its rule never ignited in the protocol; no effect could occur
long-duration-sedimentation: improved ['peak_dev_forward', 'recovery_region', 'turn_settling_after_push'] without a detectable weakening elsewhere (no Fragility Transfer)

numerical_method: RK4 on the N-link planar Lagrangian equations with the muscle drive held over each step; batched seeds with common random numbers; first-order activation dynamics; digests over 6 significant digits

design.label_rule: BH q < 0.05 over 168 tests and |d| >= 0.8; falls alone are not a transfer
design.reading: with 12 paired seeds an effect of about 0.81 (standardised, paired) is detectable with 80% power at the 0.05 level; smaller true effects are expected to be missed, so 'no detectable effect' is not 'no effect'

results.reading: Conditions are compared with the matched control on identical seeds. 'No detectable effect' is not 'no effect' (see design.min_detectable_dz).

columns: of which the rule line (mean, vs ablation)
